paragraphs.text: Steward Akal Pakal is the human leader of the Oltec on Ixalan . She is the sister of Anim Pakal .

Pakal wears layers of blue, green, and gold ceremonial robes with intricate geometric patterns. Large gold disks hang from her neck, and a tall headpiece engraved with glyphs adorns her head. Her voice is warm and husky with age.
Pakal met with the explorers after the seal at Matzalantli was opened in 5 Dawn Era .
